enforcement_legend.schema_only: The mutation is a structural resource case; no public runtime error code is asserted.
enforcement_legend.semantic_only: The vector must be fully resealed/rebound with otherwise valid dependencies, then later semantic replay must reject it; no public runtime code or precedence is asserted here.
enforcement_legend.both_required: The schema-side structural constraint and the later semantic invariant both require coverage; semantic replay still requires full reseal/rebind and carries no asserted public runtime code here.

provenance.correction_note: R2 corrects R1 timestamp and overclaims: semantic vectors assert only that later replay must reject after full reseal/rebind with otherwise valid dependencies; public error codes and precedence are intentionally unasserted. Selected-format OID-width and commit-cardinality checks remain semantic. Fixed profile/admission constants and request hard maxima retain structural expectations where R12 permits them. Profile cases anchor the not-yet-created installed profile, and unavailable normalized-other/unsupported/typed anchors are explicitly labeled.
semantic_replay_protocol: Start from an otherwise valid positive dependency set.
Reseal every mutated envelope and recompute dependent ce1 IDs and saved-byte refs.
Rebind all unchanged references, profile hash, and derived equality inputs.
Only then run later public replay; this artifact does not assert its final error code or precedence.
